FFW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Burning to both the caster and the target.

FFE.description: Deals (1*b) damage and decreases the target's Defense by (1*b) for the match.

FFL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Burning to the target.

FFD.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) bonus damage if the target is Burning, and an additional (n*b) bonus damage if the target is Vulnerable.

WWF.condition_required: the target is Charged or Burning
WWF.description: Deals (1*b) damage and decreases the target's Potency by (1*b) for the match; if the target is Charged or Burning, further decreases their Potency by (n*b) and removes the condition from them.

WWW.description: Cleanses all status effects from the caster. Also, grants the caster an extra rune the next round, but decreases the caster's potency by (1*b) for the match.

WWE.description: Changes the weather condition to Raining (buffs Water & Plants by 20 percent, and nerfs Earth & Fire by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

WWL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and removes all buffs from the target.

WWD.condition_required: the target is Weakened, Vulnerable, Slowed, or Jinxed
WWD.description: Significantly decreases the target's stats, based on any of their active debuffs, for the match: decreases Potency by (n*b) if Weakened, Defense by (n*b) if Vulnerable, Speed by (n*b) if Slowed, and Luck by (n*b) if Jinxed. If the target has none of these, decreases a random stat by (1*b).

EEF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; deals (n*b) bonus damage and applies Stunned to the target if the target is Frosty.

EEW.description: Grants the caster the Shielded buff, increases Defense by (1*b) for the match, and cures Vulnerable if afflicted.

EEE.description: Deals (1*b) damage plus bonus damage equal to (1*b) percent of the target's maximum health.

EEL.description: Deals damage scaling with the caster's Health ((1*b) * Health).

EED.description: Deals randomly between 4 and 1n instances of (1*b) damage to the target (chance to deal more instances scales with Luck).

LLF.description: Grants the caster a random buff and cures Cursed if afflicted; if Cursed was cured, additionally grants the Blessed buff.

LLW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Jinxed to the target.

LLE.description: Changes the weather condition to Sunny (buffs Fire, Light, and Plants each by 20 percent, and nerfs Dark and Ice by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

LLL.description: Heals the caster for (1*b) and increases all stats by (1*b) for the match.

LLD.condition_required: Weather is Sunny AND Caster is Blessed
LLD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; grants sequential payoffs for each condition met (Weather is Sunny, Caster is Blessed), plus triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage when all conditions are fulfilled.

DDF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) bonus damage if the target is Asleep.

DDW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Weakened to the caster.

DDE.description: Changes the weather condition to Darkness (buffs Dark & Fey by 20 percent, and nerfs Light by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

DDL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Weakened to the target.

DDD.description: Deals (1*b) damage and decreases all of the target's stats by (1*b) for the match.

FWF.description: Deals (1*b) damage with a chance to apply Burning to the target (chance scales with Luck).

FWW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Cursed to the target.

FWE.description: Changes the location to Graveyard (buffs Ghostfire & Dark by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

FWL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Cursed to the caster.

FWD.condition_required: Target is Cursed, Weather is Blood Rain, AND Location is Graveyard
FWD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; grants sequential payoffs for each condition met (Target is Cursed, Weather is Blood Rain, Location is Graveyard), plus triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage when all conditions are fulfilled.

WFF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) bonus damage if the target is Bleeding.

WFW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and decreases the target's Potency and Luck by (1*b) for the match.

WFE.description: Deals (1*b) damage with a chance to apply Bleeding to the target (chance scales with Luck).

WFL.description: Grants the caster the Lucky buff, an increase of (1*b) to Luck for the match, and cures Jinxed if afflicted.

WFD.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if Shielded, consumes it to deal (n*b) bonus damage scaled from Defense. If Lucky, consumes it to deal (n*b) bonus damage scaled from Luck.

FEF.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Vulnerable to the target.

FEW.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) bonus damage if the target is Entangled.

FEE.description: Gives the caster Charged and a Fire rune to their rune pool.

FEL.description: Gives the caster Lucky and a Water rune to their rune pool.

FED.description: Deals (1*b) damage a number of times equal to (x + 1)**n if x <= n else (4 * x if x <= 6 else x + 18), where x is the total number of debuffs on the target.

EFF.description: Decreases the target's Defense by (1*b) for the match. If the target is Vulnerable, removes it and gives the caster Lucky and Quickened.

EFW.description: Gives the caster Shielded and an Earth rune to their rune pool.

EFE.description: Deals (1*b) damage and increases the caster's max health by (1*b) for the match.

EFL.description: Heals the caster for (1*b) and applies Poisoned to the target.

EFD.condition_required: Target is Entangled AND Location is Jungle
EFD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; grants sequential payoffs for each condition met (Target is Entangled, Location is Jungle), plus triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage when all conditions are fulfilled.

FLF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) bonus damage if the target is Stunned.

FLW.description: Deals (1*b) damage with a chance to apply Stunned to the target (chance scales with Luck).

FLE.description: Changes the weather condition to Storming (buffs Lightning & Water by 20 percent, and nerfs Beasts & Light by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

FLL.description: Grants the caster the Quickened buff and grants priority on the next turn (caster's next spell resolves first regardless of Speed).

FLD.condition_required: Target is Stunned, Caster is Charged, AND Weather is Storming
FLD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; grants sequential payoffs for each condition met (Target is Stunned, Caster is Charged, Weather is Storming), plus triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage when all conditions are fulfilled.

LFF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) bonus damage if the target is Vulnerable.

LFW.description: Grants the caster the Charged buff, increases Potency by (1*b) for the match, and cures Weakened if afflicted.

LFE.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the weather is Storming, applies Stunned to the target.

LFL.description: Deals (1*b) damage; If the caster is Weakened, removes it and replaces it with Vulnerable, increasing the caster's Potency by (n*b) for the match.

LFD.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) damage if the caster is Charged and then applies Stunned to the caster.

FDF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) bonus damage if the caster is Invisible.

FDW.description: Deals (1*b) damage to the caster and target.

FDE.description: Changes the weather condition to Blood Rain (buffs Blood & Ghostfire by 20 percent, and nerfs Fey by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

FDL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Bleeding to the target.

FDD.condition_required: Target is Jinxed AND Weather is Darkness
FDD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; grants sequential payoffs for each condition met (Target is Jinxed, Weather is Darkness), plus triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage when all conditions are fulfilled.

DFF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; deals (n*b) bonus damage if the caster is Bleeding, and (n*b) bonus damage if the weather condition is Blood Rain.

DFW.description: Deals (1*b) damage to the caster and applies Bleeding and Slowed to the target.

DFE.description: Deals (1*b) damage to the caster, gives the caster Charged and Lucky, and cures Asleep if afflicted.

DFL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and heals the caster for 100 percent of the damage dealt.

DFD.description: Deals (1*b) damage to the target, dealing bonus damage scaling with the caster's missing health.

WEF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the location is Jungle, deals (n*b) bonus damage and changes the location to none.

WEE.description: Changes the location to Jungle (buffs Beasts & Plants by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

WEL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Entangled to the target.

WED.description: Deals (1*b) damage; grants sequential payoffs for each condition met (active seedling has been rained on, sunny), plus deals (n*b) bonus damage when all conditions are fulfilled.

EWF.description: Heals the caster for (1*b) and increases Potency by (1*b) for the match; if the weather is Sunny, heals for an additional (1*b).

EWW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Poisoned to the target.

EWE.description: Plants a seedling on the battlefield that can grow over time.

EWL.description: Deals (1*b) damage to the target; if an active seedling is on the battlefield, consumes it to grant the caster Quickened.

EWD.description: Deals (1*b) damage. If the target is Entangled, additionally applies Bleeding to the target.

WLF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) bonus damage if the target is Cursed.

WLW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Cursed to the target.

WLE.description: Changes the location to Enchanted Forest (buffs Fey by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

WLL.description: Casts the last spell the target casted, (Random spell if first spell of match)

WLD.condition_required: Target is Asleep, Weather is Darkness, AND Location is Enchanted Forest
WLD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; grants sequential payoffs for each condition met (Target is Asleep, Weather is Darkness, Location is Enchanted Forest), plus triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage when all conditions are fulfilled.

LWF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the location is Enchanted Forest, additionally applies Vulnerable to the target.

LWW.description: Deals (1*b) damage with a chance (scales with luck)  to apply asleep to the target.

LWE.description: Grants the caster the Invisible buff for 2 rounds.

LWL.description: Applies Polymorphed to the target for 2 rounds.

LWD.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the target is Polymorphed, consumes the status effect to grant the caster Invisible for 2 rounds.

WDF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the weather is Raining, changes the weather to Snowing and applies Stunned to the target.

WDW.description: Grants the caster the Shielded buff; while active, if the caster takes a new instance of damage, applies Frosty to the attacker.

WDE.description: Changes the weather condition to Snowing (buffs Ice by 20 percent, and nerfs Fire & Plants by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

WDL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Frosty to the target.

WDD.condition_required: Weather is Blizzard AND Location is Tundra
WDD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; grants sequential payoffs for each condition met (Weather is Blizzard, Location is Tundra), plus triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage when all conditions are fulfilled.

DWF.description: Deals (1*b) damage with a chance to apply Frosty to the target (chance scales with Luck).

DWW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Slowed to the target.

DWE.description: Changes the location to Tundra (buffs Ice by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

DWL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Frosty to the caster and target.

DWD.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the target is Frosty, consumes the effect to deal (n*b) bonus damage and apply Vulnerable.

ELF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the caster is Bleeding, removes it and changes weather to Blood Rain.

ELW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Slowed to the target.

ELE.description: Changes the weather condition to Windy (buffs Wind by 20 percent, and nerfs Earth by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

ELL.description: Grants the caster the Quickened buff, increases Speed by (1*b) for the match, and cures Slowed if afflicted.

ELD.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) bonus damage if the weather is Raining, and changes weather to Blizzard.

LEF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) bonus damage if the target is Burning.

LEW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and re-applies any debuff on the target, effectively resetting its duration.

LEE.description: Changes the weather condition to Sandstorm (buffs Earth & Wind by 20 percent, and nerfs Beasts by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

LEL.description: Gives the caster Quickened and applies Slowed to the target.

LED.description: Deals damage scaling with the caster's Speed ((1*b) * Speed).

EDF.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) bonus damage if the target is Weakened.

EDW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and decreases the target's Potency and Defense by (1*b) for the match.

EDE.description: Changes the location to Swamp (buffs Poison by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

EDL.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Poisoned to the target.

EDD.condition_required: Target is Bleeding AND Location is Swamp
EDD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; grants sequential payoffs for each condition met (Target is Bleeding, Location is Swamp), plus triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage when all conditions are fulfilled.

DEF.description: Deals (1*b) damage scaling with the target's missing Potency.

DEW.description: Deals (1*b) damage and decreases the target's Potency and Luck by (1*b) for the match.

DEE.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Weakened to the target.

DEL.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the target is Bleeding, additionally applies Infected to the target.

DED.description: Deals (1*b) damage and removes any debuffs on target to heal the caster for each removed.

LDF.description: Deals (1*b) damage and applies Jinxed to the target.

LDW.description: Deals (1*b) damage with a chance to apply Stunned to the target (chance scales with Luck).

LDE.description: Changes the location to Space (buffs Cosmic by 20 percent). Grants a secondary match-long multiplier for associated classes (tuned via b, e.g. 1.05x) and requires the current non-default environment to be active for >= 3 turns to change.

LDL.description: Deals (1*b) damage, dealing (n*b) bonus damage if the target is Jinxed.

LDD.condition_required: Target has Jinxed, Weakened, Slowed, AND Vulnerable
LDD.description: Deals (1*b) base damage; grants sequential payoffs for each condition met (Target has Jinxed, Weakened, Slowed, Vulnerable), plus triggers ultimate animation and deals an additional (n*b) bonus damage when all conditions are fulfilled.

DLF.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the target is Slowed, consumes it to increase the caster's Speed.

DLW.description: Deals (1*b) damage to the target, And gives the caster a Dark rune to their rune pool.

DLE.description: Heals (1*b) the caster and Gives the caster a Light rune to their rune pool.

DLL.description: Deals (1*b) damage; if the weather condition is Darkness, gives the caster Quickened, and applies Slowed to the target.

DLD.description: Deals (1*b) damage scaling with the target's missing health.
